razonamiento: The visual diagram shows NHS Digital's secure analytics architecture. Users connect to an EC2 instance hosting Apache Guacamole for remote desktop/bastion access, which authenticates against AWS Directory Service. Analytics environments run on separate EC2 instances (hosting tools such as RStudio, JupyterHub, and Hue) and Amazon EMR, both accessing encrypted data stored in Amazon S3. S3 is integrated bidirectionally with AWS KMS for encryption. An Amazon RDS instance is drawn on the board (likely supporting Apache Ranger metadata) without drawn edges. All drawn bidirectional connections are represented as paired directional edges reflecting request/response or read/return interactions.
